title: Why every developer should learn Rust in 2026

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know 65% of developers are now using Rust for system-level code?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: In 2026, memory safety and performance are no longer optional — they're essential.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Rust is a systems programming language that prevents crashes without a garbage collector.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Its ownership model ensures zero runtime errors, making code safer and faster.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Web3, AI, and IoT projects are adopting Rust at an unprecedented rate.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Rust gives you control without sacrificing safety.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Ready to future-proof your skills? Let me know in the comments.
